scope: Randomized variants of the 2 to 5 target requests of the Elemental and Enhancement Shaman reference builds and their hand-edited variants (validation/2026-10-06-multi-target-shaman-sweep/*.base.json, application revision 3923f70de): 16 for each of 8 bases at 200 iterations (seed 20261006, and 20261008 for the multidot and in-front bases), each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust. The sweep sets every copy of the boss to the variant's level, so the targets stay identical.
generator: python3 tools/sweep.py validation/2026-10-06-multi-target-shaman-sweep/SPEC-N-targets.base.json --seed 20261006 --count 16 --iterations 200 --output <scratch>/SPEC-N for each base, adding --max-distance 5 for the melee Enhancement bases and using --seed 20261008 for elemental-shaman-multidot-flame-shock-5 and enhancement-shaman-front-3; each variant <scratch>/SPEC-N/sweep-XX.json is compared as SPEC-N-sweep-XX.request.json
rerun: python3 tools/prepared_v2.py compare --output <scratch> <variants>/*.request.json, with the variants renamed as the generator says

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2
